turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son turns six next month and he wants a big party.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! Would you rather host it at home, or book a place like a trampoline park?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Front row or back row? I'm booking now.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not front row. I'll get a sore neck.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Middle's perfect. And the aisle, I always need the loo.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course you do. Do you want the big popcorn deal?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Only if it comes with a drink. Otherwise it's a rip off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It does. Okay, two tickets, half past seven.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Great. Can you pay and I'll send you the money later?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sure. Remember to actually send it this time.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Any thoughts on where to host your son's party?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let's book the trampoline park. Less cleanup for me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Smart. Call soon, weekend slots fill up fast, and ask what food they include.
